items.title: Messi says goodbye to Argentina
items.summary: Lionel Messi played his last game for Argentina. "The moment has arrived. I leave in peace, I gave it my all," he wrote. In the farewell match he set up Nico Paz, who inherits the No. 10 shirt, then gave a final speech as teammates and fans cried. Fabrizio Romano's post of his message got 131K likes, and Messi was among X's top trends.
items.author: @FabrizioRomano

post.name: Fabrizio Romano
post.text:
🩵🤍 Lionel Messi’s message: “The moment has arrived. I leave in peace, I gave it my all”.

“This shirt was my dream, my pride, and my life for years”.

“Thank you for loving me so much, thank you for support”.

“I will always carry you with me”.
